name: web-fitness-age-stat-card-with-black-background-and-progress-track
title: Black rounded card 'Fitness Age' with a huge 30.5, a thin track and '37 Your Age', and a stopwatch icon button
whatItIs: A black card on white with a small title 'Fitness Age' and a round dark stopwatch icon at the top, a very large white '30.5' at the left, a thin grey track in the middle and a smaller '37' with 'Your Age' at the right.
whatItMeans: Bold and simple; two numbers and a line tell a comparison at a glance.
techniques: Set the hero number very large.
Compare with a smaller second number.
Link them with a thin track.

vocabulary.definition: The main figure set very large.
Two numbers shown side by side.
A thin line implying a scale.
A small round icon in a corner.
